summary: Track 19.21 + 19.21b Employee Records Intelligence Platform validated end-to-end. All 56 lock tests + 10 live e2e curl tests + full Playwright browser walkthrough pass. Employee 360° page (identity header, story paragraph, 7 tabs, timeline spine, right rail with Current State + Records by Category + HR Compliance Brief + Historical Records deep links) renders correctly for Alec Perkins. Historical Records Intake shows all 4 lanes for HR super-admin, lane switching changes record-type dropdown, Safety lane reveals Incident-linkage field, Asset lane reveals Asset-ID linkage field, HR/Corporate Import lanes do NOT. Full stage-for-approval + approve + reject + reassign flows verified against the live backend. Backend permission gating enforced (Safety token 403 on HR lane, 200 on Safety lane; vocabulary properly scopes allowed_lanes_for_actor; unauth = 401). Source-file preservation contract (source_file_ref/hash/name/size) verified round-trip through upload→create→get. Audit ledger contains record_created + record_approved events with actor_email/actor_role/ts. Disallowed .exe extension → 400.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires repeatedly on Employee 360°. Timeline events use `key={e.id}` at line 255 but the fan-out endpoint can return multiple events with the same underlying id across different sources (e.g. driver_qualification vs hr_lifecycle both surfacing cdl_expiration_date). Non-blocking, but React may drop or duplicate nodes. Recommend `key={`${e.source}-${e.source_id}-${idx}`}`.

Upload endpoint computes SHA-256, enforces MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES with 413, extension allowlist with 400 for .exe — verified live.
Record create wraps in {ok, record}; approve/reject/reassign flows all wrap similarly — frontend correctly unwraps.
Employee 360° page is strictly read-only against /api/hr/employees/{id}/accountability/timeline — zero mutation verbs.
Token headers correctly use X-HR-Token/X-Safety-Token/X-Admin-Token (not Bearer) — Phase A bug is fixed.
